standard_prerequisites.name: Standard smooth refactoring of an ind-smooth map
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the standard smooth presentation of the mod-I factorization.

standard_prerequisites.name: Smooth maps are formally smooth
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts the mod-I isomorphism B/IB -> A'/IA' to an R-algebra map B -> A'.

standard_prerequisites.name: Nakayama's lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Promotes the mod-I surjection B -> A' to a surjection.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite presentation of kernels
standard_prerequisites.use: The kernel J of B -> A' is finitely generated and contained in IB.

core_obligations: Factor A/IA -> Lambda/ILambda through a standard smooth algebra bar-B over R/I by the colimit hypothesis and the colimit-standard-smooth lemma.

Lift the relations and the I-coefficients: define A' = A[t_1,...,t_r, delta_{ij}]/(g_i - sum epsilon_{ij} delta_{ij}) with its displayed map to Lambda; then A'/IA' = bar-B[delta] is standard smooth over R/I.
Choose a presentation of A'/IA' with invertible Jacobian and set B = R[x_1,...,x_n, x_{n+1}]/(f_1, ..., f_c, x_{n+1} det(df_j/dx_i) - 1); B is smooth over R.

By formal smoothness lift the mod-I isomorphism to an R-algebra map B -> A'; Nakayama makes it surjective; write A' = B/J with J finitely generated and contained in IB, and compose to get A -> B/J -> Lambda.
proof_roadmap: Standard smooth factorization mod I; coefficient lifting in A'; smooth presentation B; formal smoothness lift; Nakayama and kernel finiteness.
difficulty_reason: A four-step lifting construction; the substance is the presentation of A' with the delta variables and the formal-smoothness lift.
